L31·N8693unmasked layer
This neuron has no clean lexical trigger: it fires weakly-to-moderately on ordinary mid-sentence continuation tokens (prepositions/determiners/openers like " of", " with", " all", "(") inside fluent, well-formed prose, and is strongly suppressed at sentence/line breaks (newlines, "?") in garbled, spammy or machine-scrambled text — i.e. it tracks "coherent text continues here" vs. "incoherent segment boundary".
